$comment: Patient questionnaire questions on religious / ritual fasting and traditional or complementary treatments (patient-facing wording, information only: no advice, no medicine, no instruction verb; hazard H-10), and the "(patient-reported)" social-history line labels. A shared clinical rule file: the web (lib/triage-engine/src/lifestyle-questions.ts, APCQ: token questionnaire and web intake) and iOS (LifestyleQuestions.swift through SharedClinicalContent, front-desk iPad questionnaire) read this one file; lint:shared-content checks it against its schema and both platforms' types, and lint:patient-instructions checks the wording. Part of the lifestyle-practices rule set (same version as lifestyle-practices.json). Where the questions sit in the queue (placeLifestyleQuestions) and which templates ask them stay in code.

religious_fasting.text: Do you fast for religious or other reasons (for example Ramadan, Lent, a Daniel Fast or intermittent fasting)?
religious_fasting.helpText: This is for information only, so the team can plan your care. Select all that apply.

religious_fasting_timing.text: Are you fasting at the moment, or planning a fast soon?

options.label: Planning to fast within the next month

complementary_therapies.text: Do you use any traditional or complementary treatments (for example acupuncture, cupping, yoga, detox or cleanse programmes, vitamin drips)?
complementary_therapies.helpText: This is for information only, so the team has a full picture. Select all that apply.

options.label: Detox or cleanse programmes (including detox teas)
